mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE id = #{studentId}

SELECT a.id AS application_id, j.company_name, j.title, a.status, a.submitted_at, CAST(d.document AS CHAR) AS document FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = a.job_posting_id LEFT JOIN application_document d ON d.application_id = a.id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT i.id AS item_id, j.company_name, j.title, i.response, i.pass_reason FROM recommendation_item i JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = i.job_posting_id LEFT JOIN application a ON a.recommendation_item_id = i.id WHERE a.id IS NULL AND i.recommendation_id = ( SELECT r.id FROM recommendation r WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY i.rank_no
